payload.loop: Activate Fireworks Arrow artifact to load explosive arrow into quiver; fire with Scatter Crossbow (triggers one explosion per arrow fired = up to 3 simultaneous explosions with Scatter Crossbow's multishot); cooldown reduction via armor (Cool Down enchantment, Evocation Robe) cycles the 30-second artifact CD; loop: fire volley → wait for CD reduction → reload → fire again. No rotation; artifact CD management IS the loop.
